newsitem.title: USA: Republic says seeking more cars, security.
newsitem.headline: Republic says seeking more cars, security.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc, which earlier announced a $625 million purchase of Alamo Rent-A-Car Inc, said it will seek other acquisitions in the car industry.
"We're interested in growing in virtually every segment of the automobile industry," spokesman Ronald Castell told Reuters. He cited rental, used cars, repairs and financing.
Castell also said Republic will continue to pursue acquisitions in the security industry. The company's plan to buy security firm ADT Ltd collapsed in September.
"We get more interested in security as each day goes by," Castell said.
Republic is led by aggressive businessman Wayne Huizenga, founder of Blockbuster Entertainment and owner of several professional sports teams.
Shares of Republic rose 2-1/4 at 33-1/2 in afternoon trade in reaction to the Alamo acquisition.
